nina_sales: Heads-up: OrionHealth POC next week. They want a short capacity plan (reserved vs on-demand), autoscale knobs, and quick security answers for the RFP. Can SE/Infra/Sec draft a one-pager?

ash_se: Traffic summary from buyer: baseline ~700 RPS, avg payload 200 tokens, occasional demo spikes to 3.5k RPS for 60-90s. Target p99 <600ms. Workload: chat + retrieval.

pat_infra: Recommend reserve 5 GPUs (A100 equiv) for baseline, autoscale min=1 max=12, step=2, cooldown=25s. Add burst credits sized for three 90s spikes. Canary a quantized 8-bit route for cost trial.

leo_fin: Quick pricing note: 5-reserved commit ~30% cheaper vs on-demand for sustained hours. POC bundle: 120 GPU-hours + 60k burst tokens credit. I'll draft numbers.

sylvia_sec: Security asks: BYOK KMS, VPC peering/private link, retention windows, and PHI handling. Need one-line answers and a short attestation.

pat_infra: One-liners: "KMS: BYOK supported (customer-managed keys)", "Private control plane/VPC: available for enterprise", "Retention: configurable 7/30/90/365 days", "Logs: no-persistent-logs mode available". Attestation: we can enable redaction and no-persistent storage modes.

ash_se: POC test steps (bullet):
- Reserve 5 GPUs in customer namespace
- Autoscale policy min=1 max=12 step=2 cooldown=25s
- Provision 60k burst tokens
- Upload top25 prompts and schedule prewarm 30m prior
- Enable per-route tracing + token-cost export
- Fallback: quantized route + short-context cap + queue cap w/ Retry-After

pat_infra: Prewarm command we use: `redwoodctl prewarm --org orionhealth --prompts top25.json --duration 1800 --parallel 6` (run 25-30m before demo).

leo_fin: I'll send the POC quote and reserved vs on-demand delta in 6h.

sylvia_sec: I'll draft the RFP answers and attestation paragraph and drop them here. Legal asked for a sentence confirming we can avoid persisting customer prompts; pat pls confirm.

pat_infra: Confirmed. We can configure no-persistent-logs and provide the short attestation.

infra-bot: Prewarm job queued: prewarm-orion-3224500000 (status: queued). Will update on start/complete.
